scope: S02 v0.1 D01-D10 UI implementation; local only

credentialMutationUI.source: CUA Computer/Browser Use Confirmation Policy: Hand-Off Required
credentialMutationUI.quote: Changing a password or other authentication credential: Ask the user to take over before any new credential is entered, and have them complete the entry, confirmation, and submission steps themselves.

accessGrantUI.source: CUA Computer/Browser Use Confirmation Policy: Confirmation Required at Action time
accessGrantUI.quote: Creates or materially expands security-sensitive access: Grants a person, app, or agent new or broader access to sensitive data or security-critical systems, including through credentials, permission changes, delegation, or public exposure.
accessGrantUI.modeQuote: This is required even if the user has pre-approved the action.

manualUAT: Open a private local invitation link. Register with a new password manually, verify email from privileged local mail, sign in, complete TOTP setup manually, save backup codes privately, reauthenticate, then explicitly accept the fixed invitation.

As tenant admin, reauthenticate, verify recipient and current tenant, send an invitation, inspect local mail, resend to void the old link, then revoke. No token should appear in public UI or evidence.
As Platform Admin, reauthenticate, confirm organization and initial-admin email, submit provisioning, verify metadata and invitation without private tenant access.
Request reset using a synthetic email. Open the private reset link and let the human enter/submit a new password. Verify old sessions end and enrolled MFA remains required.
Under a disposable independent fixture, reauthenticate and revoke membership or globally disable an identity. Confirm last-admin protection without changing shared fixture access.
